title: Reference text
responsibility: Turns known unit references in ordinary text into links within the displayed workspace.

inputs.name: ReferenceText.text
inputs.description: Required plain text parsed for [[unit:<id>]] references. Unknown references and ordinary text remain as written; nothing is interpreted as markup.

inputs.name: ReferenceText.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace providing the project, revision and navigation context for resolved links.

inputs.name: ReferenceText.entity
inputs.description: Optional viewed entity, null by default, available for reference lookup before the catalog lists it.

outputs.name: ReferenceText
outputs.description: Inline text interleaved with recognized unit links and category icons. Adds no surrounding element and leaves unresolved references as text.
